name: Forensic Accountant
responsibilities: Investigate suspected fraud, embezzlement, or other financial crime by tracing transactions through statements, tax returns, and bank records
Perform forensic accounting analyses and support expert witness work: build the numbers a lawyer or court can rely on
Write up findings and recommendations in a report detailed enough to survive cross-examination or regulatory scrutiny
skills: Reconstructing a financial trail from messy source documents (bank records, tax filings, ledgers) instead of a clean data set
Using forensic and data analytics software (e.g. IDEA, ACL) to find the anomaly in a large population of transactions
Writing a findings report that holds up when read by opposing counsel, not just an internal audience
Working alongside lawyers or law enforcement and keeping client information confidential under real pressure
rawSkillPool: Bank record and tax return analysis
Working with law enforcement and legal counsel

evidence.title: Associate - Assurance, Forensic - Fraud & Investigation (2026 Graduates)
evidence.quote: Perform fraud and other forensic accounting investigation, support expert witness services, and conduct financial and economic analyses.

evidence.title: Forensic Accountant Job Description
evidence.quote: Conduct forensic accounting investigations and analyses to identify potential fraud, embezzlement, and other financial crimes; Prepare detailed reports documenting findings and recommendations for further action.
